parameters.description: Two-term Ogden-Hill (Hyperfoam) equilibrium series plus one Maxwell branch. instantaneous_shear_modulus_2_pa and hyperfoam_exponent_2 describe the second term and stay optional so single-term artifacts written before it remain valid; an absent second modulus is zero, which disables the term and reproduces the single-term law exactly. The series equilibrium shear modulus, which pins the Pasternak coupling, is the SUM (instantaneous_shear_modulus_pa + instantaneous_shear_modulus_2_pa) * equilibrium_fraction. slider_modulus_pa and slider_yield_pa add a rate-independent Jenkin (spring-slider) branch in parallel: a per-column slider stress clipped at slider_yield_pa and advanced by slider_modulus_pa per unit strain, dissipating 2 * slider_yield_pa * area * stroke per cycle; absent or zero values disable the branch and keep the viscoelastic law exact.

additionalProperties.description: One Virtual Instron fixture mapping. bed_bottom_above_platen_m holds the rest bottom height of every column_bed column over the platen at first contact, in column_bed order.

mass_kg.description: Mass of one shoe [kg]. Optional; the loader uses 0.2 kg (DEFAULT_SHOE_MASS_KG) when absent and rejects a value that is not finite and positive.
